name.en: National Food Security Act - Targeted Public Distribution System
name.hi: राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम - लक्षित सार्वजनिक वितरण प्रणाली

description.en: Foodgrain entitlements under NFSA for households identified by State/UT governments as Priority Households or Antyodaya Anna Yojana households.

application.channel: State/UT Food and Civil Supplies Department / state ration-card portal
application.instructions: Household identification and ration-card issuance are handled by the State/UT. Do not infer entitlement from income alone; check the active ration-card category and state record.

grievance.instructions: NFSA provides for State Food Commissions and District Grievance Redressal Officers. Identify the correct state authority and current contact details before referring.

sources.title: NFSA and PDS FAQs
sources.publisher: Department of Food and Public Distribution
sources.supports: PHH/AAY entitlements, state role in household identification, ONORC

verification.warning: A scheme-level status does not establish an individual's eligibility. Confirm the current state/UT implementation and official beneficiary record.

notes: NFSA coverage is state-specific; State/UT governments identify eligible households within their coverage limits.
One Nation One Ration Card enables portability for eligible NFSA beneficiaries; it does not create a new entitlement.
The current free-foodgrain policy is subject to the applicable government order and should be freshness-checked.
